final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), s AS (SELECT rating, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_ratings, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
